## Summary

<!-- Describe the change and its motivation. -->

## Type of change

- [ ] `feat`: new functionality
- [ ] `fix`: bug fix
- [ ] `docs`: documentation only
- [ ] `test`: tests only
- [ ] `refactor`: code change without behavior change
- [ ] `chore`: maintenance or repository change

## Validation

<!-- List the tests or checks you ran and their results. -->

## Review checklist

- [ ] The PR title and commit messages follow Conventional Commits, for example `feat(reminders): edit scheduled tasks`.
- [ ] Aquarium data remains correctly isolated where applicable.
- [ ] No credentials, personal information, or real aquarium data are included.
- [ ] Relevant tests and documentation have been updated.
